{"lines":[{"lineId":"4","lineNum":6,"lineType":1,"content":"坤壬乙，巨門從頭出。艮丙辛位，位是破軍㢲，辰亥，盡是","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":8,"lineType":1,"content":"武曲位。甲癸申，貪狼一路行。左為陽，子丑至戌亥。右為","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":10,"lineType":1,"content":"隂，午巳至申未。雌與雄，交㑹合元空。雄與雌，元空卦內","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":12,"lineType":1,"content":"推。山與水，須要明此理。水與山，禍福盡相闗。明元空，只","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":14,"lineType":1,"content":"在五行中。知此法，不須尋納甲。顛顛倒，二十四山有珠","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":16,"lineType":1,"content":"寳。逆順行，二十四山有火坑。認金龍，一經一緯義不窮。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452560963190834"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":20,"lineType":1,"content":"動不動，直待髙人施妙用。第一義，要識龍身行與止。第","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":22,"lineType":1,"content":"二元，來脉明堂不可偏。第三法，傳送功曺不髙壓。第四","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":24,"lineType":1,"content":"竒，明堂十字有元微。第五妙，前後青龍兩相照。第六秘，","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":26,"lineType":1,"content":"八國城門鎻正氣。第七奥，要向天心尋十道。第八裁，屈","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":28,"lineType":1,"content":"曲流神認去來。第九神，任他平地與侵雲。第十真，若有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":30,"lineType":1,"content":"一缺非真情。明倒杖，卦坐隂陽何必想。識掌模，太極分","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":32,"lineType":1,"content":"明必有圖。知化氣，生克制化須熟記。説五星，方圓尖秀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":34,"lineType":1,"content":"要分明。曉髙低，星峯須辨得元㣲。鬼與曜，生死去來真","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452548418158601"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":38,"lineType":1,"content":"要妙。向放水，生旺有吉休囚否？二十四山分五方，知得","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":40,"lineType":1,"content":"榮枯死與生。翻天倒地對不同，其中秘宻在元空。認龍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":42,"lineType":1,"content":"立穴要分明，在人仔細辨天心。天星既辨穴何難，但把","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":44,"lineType":1,"content":"向中放水看。從外生入名為進，定知財寳積如山。從內","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":46,"lineType":1,"content":"生出名為退，家內錢財皆廢盡。生入剋入名為旺，子孫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":48,"lineType":1,"content":"髙官盡富貴。脉息生旺要知因，龍歇脉寒災禍臨。縱有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":50,"lineType":1,"content":"他山來救助，空勞禄馬護龍行。勸君再把星辰辨，吉凶禍","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":52,"lineType":1,"content":"福如神見。識得此篇真妙微，又見郭璞再出現。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7426452547805855744"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":56,"lineType":1,"content":"青囊奥語","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
